title: Pet Mode keeps your dog chillin’
Robots Doing Stuff #64 | Delicate Object Handling
summary:
Will you find crackers and grapes on the production floor? Probably not. But what you will find are tasks that require the manipulation of delicate, irregular, and easily damaged objects. Brittle crackers and soft grapes provide a simple way to put those capabilities to the test.

Handling objects like these requires precise force control and continuous adjustment. The hand must maintain a secure grasp without crushing, cracking, or dropping each object as it transfers it to the plate.

It makes for a great demo… and a great snack.
